sql: SELECT c.id, c.lead_id, c.bot_step, c.bot_enabled, c.bot_data->>'ai_agent' AS ai, c.last_message_from_me, c.last_message_at, c.ai_journey_next_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM wapi_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.timestamp > now() - interval '3 hours') AS msgs_3h FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.instance_id = '75feab3b-eb12-44f0-8ada-463e5540c869' AND c.bot_step = 'ai_agent' ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC LIMIT 3
